title: Daily weather history by city, 1950-2025 (UK, Germany, France, Portugal, Luxembourg, Serbia)
description:
Daily weather values (mean, minimum and maximum temperature, precipitation, wind, solar radiation) from 2 January 1950 (3 January 1950 in France, Germany, Luxembourg and Serbia, one hour ahead of UTC) to 31 December 2025 for the largest cities, from the ERA5-Land reanalysis.

Columns. country, city_id, name, date, tmean_c (°C), tmin_c (°C), tmax_c (°C), precip_mm (mm), wind_mean_kmh (km/h), wind_max_kmh (km/h), solar_kwh_m2 (kWh/m²).

Method. Copernicus ERA5-Land hourly reanalysis, 0.1° grid, nearest cell to the city point, local civil days (IANA time zone, complete days only). Temperatures are adjusted for altitude at 6.5 °C per km; precipitation is not adjusted.

Limits. Grid-cell reanalysis values, not station measurements. Hot days in city centres are undercounted. Degree days differ from figures published by national services.

Places. France and Germany: the 100 most populous municipalities by official population (France: INSEE population from the "Liste des communes de France" file on data.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte 2.0; Germany: BKG VG250-EW, © GeoBasis-DE / BKG (2026), dl-de/by-2-0, data changed (climate values added)). One point per municipality (city districts such as the Paris arrondissements are not separate cities); names are the official municipality names; the point and time zone come from GeoNames (cities5000), CC BY 4.0. Great Britain (100), Portugal (20), Serbia (20) and Luxembourg (5): the most populous GeoNames (cities5000) places, skipping a place that lies in the same 0.1 degree grid cell and district as a larger one. The population column is the official municipal population in France and Germany and the GeoNames population elsewhere; city_id is the GeoNames id. Files are named <cc>_... per country (gb, de, fr, pt, lu, rs).
